_comment: Central domain routing on the dedicated nginx VM. Names are labels below lab.json's
domain; @ is the domain itself. Backend addresses are always taken from lab.json vms,
never from public DNS, to avoid proxy loops. TLS is passed through unchanged: the services
keep their own certificates and private keys. Publishing a route also requires the
corresponding lab.json published port to use targetVm: nginx.
Vault retains end-to-end TLS and receives the original client IP through trusted PROXY
protocol. This preserves source-bound tokens and the PC's certificate pinning.
Matrix media ports stay direct; only its HTTP and HTTPS entry points use nginx.
RustFS and firewall routes additionally enforce the existing source policy: the configured PC and
private lab network only, including connections arriving through another published IP.
